{"code": "from statsmodels.stats.proportion import proportions_ztest

# Compute conversion rates by channel
n_email = cross_tab_channel.loc['email', 'All']
conversions_email = cross_tab_channel.loc['email', 1]
rate_email = conversions_email / n_email

n_paid_search = cross_tab_channel.loc['paid_search', 'All']
conversions_paid_search = cross_tab_channel.loc['paid_search', 1]
rate_paid_search = conversions_paid_search / n_paid_search

# Perform z-test for difference in proportions
count = [conversions_email, conversions_paid_search]
nobs = [n_email, n_paid_search]

z_stat, p_value = proportions_ztest(count, nobs)

print(f"Z-statistic: {z_stat:.3f}, p-value: {p_value:.3f}")
print(f"Email conversion rate: {rate_email:.3f}")
print(f"Paid search conversion rate: {rate_paid_search:.3f}")"}
